We find out on Saturday if we are having a baby boy or a baby girl. I’ve had time to reflect today, and watching the woman who you’ve fallen head over heals for carry this baby and deal with all of the stuff that go along with it is second to none. It is astronomical.

My point in all of this, is that in the almost 5 months that she has carried out beautiful baby, she has shown nothing but toughness and will, and love for this WHOLE PERSON growing inside of her. And not once has she stopped, it’s truly unimaginable how she does it so so well.

And on Saturday, when the time comes to see who our baby is going to be, all I know is that the surreal love I feel now will only be surpassed by the love for the beautiful, unbeatable mother and our baby boy or girl. And every day, these feeling just grow and grow.

I don’t know what to expect in the next 4-5 months. We’re both first time parents and are learning every day as we go. But one thing is for certain: the love I have for our soon to be family is indescribable. She is going to be an incredible mother just like she has been so far.
